name: SagDIG
tagline: Sagittarius Dwarf Irregular — the Local Group's most metal-poor gas-rich galaxy, 3.45 Mly out.

facts.label: Metallicity
facts.value: Lowest of the gas-rich LG dwarfs

history: SagDIG is the most metal-poor gas-rich galaxy in the Local Group — a small irregular whose stars carry so few heavy elements they approach the composition of the earliest galaxies ever formed. Its isolation means it has never been tidally stripped or ram-pressure-scrubbed, making it a near-laboratory sample of unprocessed evolution. It continues to form stars at a gentle pace in its outer gas clouds.
